text:
Aisha: Ok team — DeltaSys dedicated bring-up tomorrow 09:00 PT. Quick checklist: quota bump applied? autoscale policy ready? warm-surge load plan? Who can own runbook + smoke?
Ben: I applied the quota bump to account delta-sys (commit Q-842). Confirmed with billing. :white_check_mark:
Marta: Autoscaler draft pushed to PR #412. Policy: min_nodes=2 max_nodes=12 target_rps=1500. Need eng signoff on warmup windows and cooldown.
Liam: Reviewing PR now. Two asks: increase KV cache size and add longer initial cooldown (600s). Also enable fallback model variant for first 10m after cutover.
Suzanne: I'll own the ops runbook and the #delta-ops channel. Added preliminary steps here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1DeltaWarmup (will update with exact commands). Will post final runbook 1hr before.
loadtest-bot: Load test scheduled: 2026-03-22T16:00Z. Plan: 30m ramp, 90m steady at ~1.2x expected peak. Artefacts will upload to /shared/delta-warmup/.
Ben: Quick load test commands i'm planning:
```
k6 run --vus 300 --duration 2h scripts/dedicated_warmup.js
```
Marta: Alternative spike profile with vegeta: 
```
echo 'GET http://redwood-delta.internal/v1/predict' | vegeta attack -rate=2000/s -duration=90m | vegeta report
```
Liam: Also remember to route test traffic to the reserved pool header: `X-Redwood-Pool: delta-reserved`. And set `accept-model: delta-v1-quant` for the quantized variant.
Suzanne: Dashboards to watch: latency p50/p95/p99, error rate (%), GPU util (per-card), queue length, prefix cache hit ratio. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/delta/warmup-overview
Aisha: Owners: runbook @suzanne, autoscale @marta, loadtest @ben + @loadtest-bot, eng signoff @liam. I'll coordinate the post-run sync. Any blockers?
Ben: One blocker — infra needs to approve temporary concurrency bump on reserved pool. Raised JIRA INFRA-1377 and notified infra team.
Liam: I can merge the autoscaler PR once INFRA-1377 is cleared. Otherwise looks good. :thumbsup:
Suzanne: Rollback plan in runbook: reduce traffic to 10%, switch routing to hosted fallback `delta-hosted-v2`, and drain new nodes. I'll paste exact curl commands in doc.
loadtest-bot: Post-run summary (metrics + raw logs) will be uploaded to /shared/delta-warmup/summary-<timestamp>.json and ping this thread.
Aisha: Perfect. I'll do a quick 08:00 PT smoke (10m, low-rps) to validate health checks before main run. Ping @everyone if anything changes. Thanks all! :rocket:
